skill.name: web-design-guidelines
skill.description: Review UI code against Web Interface Guidelines for accessibility, usability, and design consistency issues.
skill.summary: Review selected UI files against current Web Interface Guidelines and report concise file:line findings.
skill.author: antfu

security_audit.summary: Two external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and a fenced URL block, not executable shell code. The hardcoded GitHub raw URL is a real network dependency, and the skill also tells the agent to treat mutable remote content as review rules. No evidence found of credential access, local code execution, or explicit prompt injection text in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the guideline URL to an immutable commit or vendor the guideline file into the skill.

remediation.issue: Remote content controls review rules and output format
remediation.suggestion: State that fetched content is untrusted reference material and cannot override higher-priority instructions.
Document the network requirement and provide an offline fallback for restricted environments.

static_findings.snippet: 4. Output findings in the terse `file:line` format

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 19 uses Markdown inline code to describe a file:line output format. It does not invoke a shell, evaluate Ruby, or execute user-controlled input.
Lines 25-27 are a Markdown fenced block containing a URL. The backticks are documentation formatting, not Ruby or shell execution.
The skill instructs the agent to fetch a hardcoded external GitHub raw URL before each review. This creates a real network dependency on mutable remote content.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Remote Instruction Source
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent to fetch fresh guidelines and apply all rules and output format instructions from remote content. A changed remote file could alter review behavior or introduce malicious instructions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly requires fetching mutable remote guidance and treating it as the source of rules and output format. The risk depends on the remote source changing, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.value_statement: Interface reviews often miss accessibility, usability, and consistency issues. This skill fetches Web Interface Guidelines and checks selected files against them.
actual_capabilities: Fetches current Web Interface Guidelines from the configured source.
Reviews user-specified files or asks which files to inspect.
Checks UI code for accessibility, UX, and interface guideline issues.
Reports findings in concise file:line format.
Applies the fetched guideline rules and output format instructions.
limitations: Requires network access to fetch the latest guideline source.
Depends on mutable external guidelines unless the source is pinned or vendored.
Reviews only files or patterns provided by the user.
Produces review findings, not automatic code fixes or visual screenshots.

use_cases.title: Audit a pull request UI change
use_cases.description: Review changed interface files before merge and return exact file:line findings.

use_cases.title: Validate implementation against design intent
use_cases.description: Check whether delivered UI code follows accessibility and interaction guidelines.

use_cases.title: Screen release candidates for interface issues
use_cases.description: Run a focused guideline review before launch to catch visible quality problems.

prompt_templates.title: Review one page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review app/page.tsx against Web Interface Guidelines and list findings in file:line format.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single interface file.

prompt_templates.title: Check a component set
prompt_templates.prompt: Review components/Button.tsx and components/Dialog.tsx for accessibility, interaction, and layout guideline issues.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of reusable UI components.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a feature workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the checkout flow files under app/checkout for Web Interface Guidelines compliance.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review across a related feature area.

prompt_templates.title: Run pre-release design QA
prompt_templates.prompt: Review app, components, and styles for launch-blocking Web Interface Guidelines issues. Prioritize accessibility and navigation problems.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before a product release.

output_examples.output: The skill fetches the latest guidelines, reviews the file, and returns concise file:line findings with issue descriptions.

output_examples.input: Audit a navigation component for accessibility.
output_examples.output: The output highlights missing labels, focus concerns, and layout issues tied to exact files and lines.

output_examples.input: Start a review without a file path.
output_examples.output: The skill asks which files or patterns should be reviewed before running the guideline check.

best_practices: Provide exact file paths or focused patterns to keep the review useful.
Run the review before code freeze so findings can be fixed.
Confirm network access and trust policy for the external guideline source.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to review an entire repository without a file pattern.
Do not treat fetched remote instructions as higher priority than system or user instructions.
Do not expect automatic remediation patches from a review-only skill.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews selected UI files against Web Interface Guidelines for accessibility, usability, and interface consistency.

faq.question: Does it fix code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It reports findings so a developer can decide and apply changes.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill fetches current guidelines from a configured GitHub raw URL.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect concise findings that reference files and line numbers.

faq.question: How should I scope a review?
faq.answer: Provide specific files or patterns for the page, component, or workflow you want checked.
